problems.text: Pins, the starter and install lines at v0.12.2 add a subdirectory that release does not have, so installing kmctl at v0.12.2 fails.

goals.text: Every kmctl release installs from the layout it was built with.

outcomes.change: The cutoff is v0.12.2 everywhere, release.py set follows it, and a test ties it to the tags
outcomes.checked_by: a test_plugin test that the hook hint carries the fragment for a version after v0.12.2 and not for v0.12.2, and that hooks.json still equals the hook command; test_pin and test_starter parametrised over v0.12.1, v0.12.2 (no fragment) and v0.12.3rc1, v0.13.0 (fragment); a test_release test that `set 0.12.2` writes no fragment and `set 0.13.0` writes it once, also when re-pinning a line that had it; a test that pin.py's and release.py's cutoffs agree; an integration test over the clone's `v*` tags; the starter bootstrap integration test still passes
